notes.title: A New Chapter
notes.content:
After so successful for our team, Dungless launch, we immediately took up the development of the sequel, in which they kept all that you were so loved by the first part, and at the same time fixing all its shortcomings and mistakes. And so, after a month of painstaking work, meet and love - Dungless 2!

Recycled balance, improved graphics and a new approach to arsenal literally inspired a new life in the original and made it a real gun! We all strongly advise you to try out the new part, so keep the link to the game page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1684920/dungless_2/

Many thanks for supporting us and our work faithful to you
Team ImperIumGame.

notes.title: Release
notes.content: We are release the game! It's simple and beautiful game is available in steam!
